title: Anora
tagline: Anora tokenizes claims backed by verified warehouse receipts into private, permissioned tranches.
description: Anora turns warehouse receipts into permissioned, investable credit. Commodity owners can raise working capital without selling inventory early or exposing private commercial records. Financing conditions are verified with zero-knowledge proofs, then the claim is issued as an ATS note with risk-based tranches. Eligible institutions can subscribe, trade positions through a compliance-gated secondary market, receive distributions, and follow the facility through repayment and collateral release. The prototype uses Indonesia’s Warehouse Receipt System (SRG) as its initial use case.
how_its_made: Anora uses React and Vite for role-based Borrower, Capital Provider, and Compliance workspaces, with a Bun and Hono API coordinating the facility lifecycle. Noir generates zero-knowledge eligibility proofs, which are verified on Hedera testnet. Financing claims are issued as permissioned Hedera Asset Tokenization Studio notes with tranche-specific caps and transfer rules. Privy supports account and organizational authorization, while World ID contributes identity and uniqueness verification. The system also demonstrates allowlisted transfers, freezes, pauses, custom fees, secondary-market settlement, distributions, repayment, and redemption.
auto_summary: A warehouse-receipt financing prototype that issues compliance-gated tokenized notes, verifies eligibility with zero-knowledge proofs, and manages lifecycle workflows.
